task: Expose feature-flag-gated chargeback settings (enable toggle, project-vs-cost_center attribution, inline cost center creation, read-only rendering for non-editors) in the existing project budget configuration modals.

key_reasoning.reason: Breadth across five layers but shallow, additive touches: types (projectManagement.ts, project.ts), the three-file feature-flag stack (constants/utils/hook), UnifiedProjectBudgetModal + ProjectBudgetsSection, CostCenterFormPopup reuse, ProjectDetailsPage host, and up to three stores (projects, costCenters, projectBudgets). A clear existing pattern backs each piece, so most work is composition rather than new abstraction — L, not XL.

No precedent for the multi-step save orchestration (create cost center -> PATCH project link -> save budget) spanning two stores with inconsistent error conventions (createCostCenter uses skipErrorHandling, budget-group calls toast internally) plus AC 7's user-visible partial-failure handling with no existing test template. Nested CostCenterFormPopup opens inside a budget modal where all masks are forced to !z-50 with focusOnShow={false} — no nested-popup precedent (AC 10). Host modal carries a delicate soft/hard budget-scaling effect ordering that must not be disturbed. Feature-flag gating provides staged rollout. No security-sensitivity, so held at L rather than XL — calibrated against the bundle L example (22) whose tr=4 covered credential-storage security plus config migration.

Roughly 8-12 source files modified (types, 3 feature-flag files, budget modal(s), section, page, stores) across 3+ directories, plus new test scaffolding — none of the four budget modals nor CostCenterFormPopup has existing test coverage, so AC 9 stands up new test files. Fits L (8-10 modified, 2-4 new, 3+ dirs).

Ten detailed acceptance criteria, but one genuine design gap: whether chargeback persists as a project attribute (projectsStore PATCH whitelist) or a budget-group attribute (projectBudgetsStore) is unresolved by the code, and the save path in AC 7 spans two stores. Backend support is a soft precondition ('available or coordinated'). Core defined with 1-2 open questions — M.
